response.rationale: Several T1 meta-analyses directly link motivation-related constructs to persistence (Nye 2012: interests relate to performance and persistence; Howard 2021: identified regulation relates to persistence, while external regulation showed no link), and none of the 16 items is negative, but much of the other evidence concerns how motivation is raised rather than whether it predicts persistence, and the persistence link is specific to the type of motivation (external regulation showed none).
